activity.instructions: What is the main clearly visible activity in this residential security camera video? Choose other for unfamiliar or unclear activity.

criteria.vehicle_passing_street: A vehicle drives along the street without using the driveway.
criteria.vehicle_arriving_driveway: A vehicle turns into or arrives at the driveway.
criteria.vehicle_leaving_driveway: A vehicle drives out of the driveway onto the street.
criteria.person_near_vehicle: A person approaches, enters, exits, or works around a vehicle on the property.
criteria.person_at_entrance: A person walks or stands on the property, walkway, porch, or entrance.
criteria.person_side_yard: A person walks or works in the side yard or narrow passage beside the building.
criteria.delivery_or_pickup: A person delivers or picks up a package at the property.
criteria.person_passing: A person passes along the public sidewalk or street without entering the property.
criteria.cyclist_passing: A cyclist rides a bicycle along the public street or sidewalk.
criteria.animal: A dog, cat, or another animal moves through the scene.
criteria.near_camera_obstruction: A web, insect, rain, glare or other material very near the lens obscures the scene.
criteria.no_clear_activity: No person, animal, or moving vehicle is clearly visible.
criteria.other: Another activity occurs or the activity cannot be determined from the video.
